name: Web document — YouTube (vertical)
description: Vertical (TikTok/Reels) reflow of the YouTube comment overlay — the card widens to the vertical safe-area while the look holds. Faithful site look BY DESIGN: YouTube dark theme (bg #0f0f0f), the video headline as a context line, then a comment with a round avatar, @handle · age meta, and the thumbs-up count + Reply row, inside a browser window whose address bar shows the URL — NO Syntax collage chrome (no torn edge / grit / hard offset shadow), and NO CSS glow on the captured card. Because the page is dark, the highlight runs in the dark-surface mode — the light comment text is punched to dark ink under the amber band so it stays readable. The emissive 'web page on a backlit display' look is a TypeGPU shaderPass (subpixel emission, backlight bloom, escaping-bezel halo, viewport-edge defocus), not Pack chrome. ~6s: card settles in, the highlighter draws over the hero line (~1.2→2.4s), then a long static hold a creator can freeze/extend. Transparent WebM overlay, composited over footage.

content.title: Why your build is slow — and the one-line fix
content.author: @dev_tips
content.body: Came here after fighting the bundler all week. [highlight]Turns out a console.log in a hot loop was the entire bottleneck[/highlight] — deleted it and my build went from 40s to 9s. Wild how one line can do that.
